subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Which assistant, work profile and model the subagents Flint starts run with. Without a choice here a subagent inherits its parent's assistant and work profile (long assistant instructions are shortened). This never changes what a subagent may do: its tools and approvals stay what the run allows.
subagents.headlessNote: Assistants and work profiles apply in the desktop app only. Runs from the command line follow the model choices.
subagents.defaultsDesc: Each one inherits from the run that started it unless you pick something here.
subagents.inheritDesc: Use whatever the run that started the subagent uses.
subagents.assistantDesc: The assistant a subagent works under.
subagents.profileDesc: How a subagent approaches the work.
subagents.modelDesc: Run subagents on another model, for example a faster one for read-only surveys.
subagents.letModelChooseDesc: On: a role or model the calling model asks for is used. Off: these settings always win.
subagents.precedence: Order: what the model asks for (if allowed), then the role's setting, then the setting for all subagents, then the parent.
subagents.maxConcurrentDesc: Most subagents that run at the same time (1 to 16). The rest wait their turn.
subagents.maxDepthDesc: 1: subagents cannot start subagents. 2 or 3 lets them hand work down that many levels, under the same limits and approvals.

checkForUpdatesDesc: Check if a newer version of Flint is available.
failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Failed to relocate data folder. Please try again.
factoryResetDesc: This will reset all app settings to their defaults. This can't be undone. We only recommend this if the app is corrupted.
documentationDesc: Learn how to use Flint and explore its features.
releaseNotesDesc: See what's new in the latest version of Flint.
discordDesc: Join our community for support and discussions.
reportAnIssueDesc: Found a bug? Help us out by filing an issue on GitHub.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Location for messages, downloaded models and other data.
dataFolder.unavailable: Your data folder {{path}} is not available right now: its drive may be disconnected, or the folder was moved. Flint is using the default folder shown above until it is back. Your setting has not been changed.
dataFolder.appLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the App.

others.spellCheckDesc: Enable spell check for your threads.
others.spellCheckHint: The spelling language is chosen by your system, not by Flint. Add a language in your system's language and keyboard settings (Windows: Language & region; macOS: Keyboard > Text Input; Linux: install a hunspell dictionary).
others.enterKeyNewlineDesc: Pressing Enter in the chat box adds a new line instead of sending. Send with the send button or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter. Useful when you type with an input method (IME), where Enter confirms a conversion.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Restore application to its initial state, erasing all models and chat history. This action is irreversible and recommended only if the application is corrupted.

shortcuts.pressKeys: Press the new shortcut… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.conflict: Already used by {{command}}. Choose another shortcut, or change that one first.
shortcuts.commandPaletteDesc: Open the command palette: navigation, actions, conversations and settings.
shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Cycle to the next assistant in the chat.
shortcuts.splitViewDesc: Open another conversation beside the one on screen.
shortcuts.maxPanesDesc: How many conversations split view shows at once, the main one included.
shortcuts.nextPaneDesc: Move to the next pane in split view.
shortcuts.previousPaneDesc: Move to the previous pane in split view.

interface.title: Interface
interface.fontSizeDesc: Make text larger or smaller across the app, from 14 px to 20 px. The theme and accent colour are in the same section.
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Where toast notifications appear. On Windows, the default is bottom-right so popups do not cover the window controls.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Display tokens/sec and token count inline below assistant messages. When off, a compact icon shows the details on click.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Use the accent color as the background of your messages. When off, they match assistant messages with plain text on a neutral background.
interface.renderUserMarkdownDesc: Show bold, lists, headings and code in the messages you send. When off, they show exactly as typed.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Add a Preview tab to HTML and SVG code blocks. HTML runs the model-generated page in a sandboxed frame that executes its own scripts but cannot access Flint, your files, or the network; SVG renders statically with scripts disabled. Off by default.
interface.wrapCodeLines: Wrap long lines in code blocks
interface.wrapCodeLinesDesc: Wrap long lines onto the next row, indented under the code, instead of scrolling the block sideways. The wrap button in a code block's header toggles the same setting.
interface.composerRailButtons: Output buttons in the Cowork composer
interface.composerRailButtonsDesc: Show Preview, Code, Changes, Activity and Timeline under the Cowork message box. Off, one Output button in the header opens the panel.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Automatically summarize new conversations into a thread title. Turn off to keep the default title until you rename it yourself.
interface.titleModelDesc: The model that writes automatic chat titles. If it is unavailable, the chat's own model is used.
interface.titlePromptDesc: The instruction sent with the conversation when a title is generated.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Set the app window's background color.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Set the main content area's background color.
interface.primaryDesc: Set the primary color for interface accents.
interface.accentDesc: Select the accent color used across the UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Set the highlight color for destructive actions.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Reset all interface settings to default.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: All interface settings have been restored to default.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Choose how the chat viewport should react when new messages arrive.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Keeps the viewport anchored to the latest message you send.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Automatically follows along as replies stream in real time.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Show token counter inside chat input. When disabled, token counter appears below the input.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Display line numbers in code blocks.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Reset code block style to default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Code block style has been restored to default.
interface.transcriptViewDesc: How much of each turn Chat, Cowork and Rooms show. Approvals, questions and errors always show.
interface.transcriptViewNormalDesc: The answer and anything that needs you. Tool calls fold into one steps row.
interface.transcriptViewThinkingDesc: Adds the model's reasoning. Tool calls stay folded.
interface.transcriptViewVerboseDesc: Everything: full reasoning and every tool call open with its parameters and output.
interface.inlineCitationsDesc: Show a small site icon after a sentence that comes from a web source. Turn this off to read the answer without them; the sources stay listed below it.

hardware.name: Name
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Use Vulkan API for GPU acceleration. Do not enable Vulkan if you have an NVIDIA GPU as it may cause compatibility issues.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: No GPUs are visible to the llama.cpp engine. Models will run on the CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: How llama.cpp talks to this GPU
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Use this API for this GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: The GPU shares one memory pool with the CPU — models draw from the same memory as the rest of the system.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: The URL and port of your proxy server.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Credentials for the proxy server, if required.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: A comma-separated list of hosts to bypass the proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Allow self-signed or unverified certificates. This may be required for some proxies but reduces security. Only enable if you trust your proxy.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate when connecting to the proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate of the proxy's host.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of peer connections.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of destination hosts.
httpsProxy.caBundleDesc: A PEM file of certificate authorities to trust in addition to the system's, for a company proxy or a private model gateway. Certificates are still checked -- host names, dates and the chain -- and nothing is trusted if the file cannot be used. Applies to new connections.
httpsProxy.caBundleNone: Only the platform's certificate authorities are trusted.
httpsProxy.caBundleInUse: Trusting {{count}} certificate(s) from this bundle as well as the platform's.
httpsProxy.caBundleBroken: This bundle cannot be used ({{kind}}): outbound HTTPS trusts nothing until it is fixed or removed.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslScope: Applies to all proxied traffic. A single provider can also allow invalid certificates for its own address, on its page under Model Providers.
httpsProxy.proxyUrlInvalid: This does not look like a proxy address. Use host:port or http://host:port.
httpsProxy.proxyUrlScheme: Only http, https, socks5 and socks5h proxies are supported.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslConfirmBody: Flint will accept self-signed, expired or mismatched certificates for all proxied traffic, so anyone on the path could read or alter it. Only continue if you trust the proxy and the network.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslActiveWarning: Certificate checks are off for all proxied traffic.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Let models search and read the web using Flint's built-in tools.
webSearch.enableDesc: Advertise the web_search and web_fetch tools to models that support tool use. Works out of the box with no API key.
webSearch.providerDesc: Pick a provider to set its API key or instance URL.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Optional. Provide a {{provider}} API key for higher rate limits and structured results. Leave empty to use the free keyless endpoint.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Required. {{provider}} needs an API key to return results.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Required. The base URL of your {{provider}} instance, with the JSON API enabled.
webSearch.noSetupDesc: Searches {{provider}} directly, with no API key or account. After many searches in a short time {{provider}} can ask for a bot check; wait a minute, or pick Exa or You.com, which also need no key.
webSearch.endpointSearchDesc: The base URL of your self-hosted search instance.
webSearch.searchOrderDesc: Providers are tried top to bottom; a failed or rate-limited one hands the search to the next. Keyless entries send no account identifier, keyed ones are faster but traceable to your key.
webSearch.emptyChain: No provider is on, so web search will fail. Add or turn one on.

visualize.title: Visual widgets
visualize.enabledDesc: Diagrams, mockups, charts and small interactive explainers shown inline in the conversation. Adds two short tool descriptions to each request.
visualize.cdn: Let widgets load libraries from cdnjs and jsdelivr
visualize.cdnDesc: Off by default. When on, a widget may load scripts (such as a charting library) from cdnjs.cloudflare.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net, and nowhere else. It still cannot send data out.
visualize.maxHeightDesc: A widget grows to this height in pixels, then scrolls. You can always open it full size.

agentTools.shellDescription: Where the agent's commands run, what they can reach, and how its commits are credited.
agentTools.skillsHelp: Skills are instructions the agent can load when a task needs them. Skills that come from a plugin are read-only here.
agentTools.computerAppsDesc: Leave empty to let the assistant control any app. Add apps to restrict it to only their windows (Windows only).
agentTools.computerAppsLimited: The assistant can only control windows of the apps below. Click one to remove it.
agentTools.computerExclusionsDesc: Mark parts of the screen the assistant must never click, type or scroll in, such as a button that would overwrite your save file.
agentTools.computerExclusionsCount_one: {{count}} area is off-limits to the assistant.
agentTools.computerExclusionsCount_other: {{count}} areas are off-limits to the assistant.
agentTools.computerExclusionsPick: This is your screen right now. Drag to draw each area the assistant must never act in. Position the app you care about first, then reopen this.
agentTools.attributionCommits: Add Flint as co-author on commits
agentTools.attributionCommitsDesc: Commits the agent makes end with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Flint and the model that wrote them.
agentTools.attributionPullRequests: Add 'Generated with Flint' to pull requests
agentTools.attributionPullRequestsDesc: Pull request descriptions the agent writes end with a 'Generated with Flint' line.

toolchains.title: Sandbox toolchains
toolchains.description: These are installed but the sandbox cannot run them: their folder does not allow sandboxed apps to read and run what is inside. You can allow it for one toolchain at a time.
toolchains.allRunnable: Every installed toolchain the sandbox looks for can run in it.
toolchains.unrunnable: Installed in {{folder}}, but the sandbox cannot run it.
toolchains.notGrantable: Installed, but the sandbox cannot run it, and allowing its folder would not help (Git for Windows and other MSYS2 tools never run in the sandbox).
toolchains.storeAlias: This is only the Microsoft Store alias, not an installed program. Install it, or turn the alias off in Settings > Apps > Advanced app settings > App execution aliases.
toolchains.notGrantableOther: Installed, but the sandbox cannot run it and no folder could be found to allow. Run it outside the sandbox with approval instead.
toolchains.launcher: The py launcher runs a Python installed elsewhere. It works once a Python runs in the sandbox: allow python instead.
toolchains.grantedAt: The sandbox may run what is in {{folder}}.
toolchains.confirmBody: This changes the permissions of the folder below, where {{program}} is installed, and only that folder and what is inside it: it adds an entry that lets every sandboxed Windows app (ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES) read and run the files inside it. Nothing else in your user profile is opened. You can revoke it here at any time, which removes exactly that entry.
toolchains.needsAdmin: Installed in {{folder}}, which only an administrator can change. Needs administrator: run this in an elevated terminal:
toolchains.loadError: Could not read the sandbox toolchains.
toolchains.revokeBody: This removes the permission entry that was added to the folder below. Sandboxed commands will no longer be able to run {{program}} from it.

agentTools.title: Agent Tools
agentTools.description: Give models a private scratch workspace for each conversation, plus memories and skills kept permanently in your Flint data folder.
agentTools.enableDesc: Advertise the built-in workspace, memory and skill tools to models that support tool use. Tools that need approval stay unavailable.
agentTools.chatDelegationDesc: A chat can hand a job to a subagent, or start several at once. Each subagent works with the same tools and asks before it changes anything, as the chat does. Needs the agent tools above.
agentTools.shellSandboxed: Commands run confined by {{backend}}: they can only write inside the conversation workspace, and files in your home folder are not readable.
agentTools.shellUnavailable: No sandbox is available on this system, so the bash tool is not offered. Commands are never run unconfined.
agentTools.networkDesc: Let commands reach the network. Needed for things like installing packages or fetching a repository. On by default; turn it off so a command cannot send anything off your machine.
agentTools.noMemories: No memories yet. Models add them with the memory_write tool as they learn things worth keeping.
agentTools.noSkills: No skills yet. A skill is a reusable set of instructions a model can load on demand.
agentTools.editMemoryDesc: One topic per note. Models read these back with the memory_read tool.
agentTools.editSkillDesc: Markdown instructions, optionally with a description in YAML frontmatter. The description is what models see before loading the skill.
agentTools.loadFailed: Could not load the agent workspace
agentTools.nameExists: "{{name}}" already exists. Choose another name or edit the existing one.

localApiServer.title: Local API Server
localApiServer.usageCeilingsDesc: Rolling windows over agent runs and the local API server. A client that reaches a limit gets a 429 with Retry-After.
localApiServer.usageCeilingsInvalid: Limits are whole numbers of tokens. Leave a field empty for no limit.
localApiServer.usage5hDesc: Tokens, input plus output, in the last 5 hours. Empty means no limit.
localApiServer.usageWeekDesc: Tokens, input plus output, in the last 7 days. Empty means no limit.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the local API server.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Automatically start the Local API Server when the application launches.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Keep the server running in the system tray when the window is closed. When off, closing the window quits Flint and stops the server.
localApiServer.serverHostLanWarning: 0.0.0.0 makes the server reachable from other devices on your network. Set an API key, and use the machine's LAN address (not localhost) from the other device.
localApiServer.serverHostLanNoTrusted: Trusted Hosts is empty: add the address other devices will use to reach this machine, or their requests may be rejected.
localApiServer.apiKeyRequiredLan: Set an API key before exposing the server on 0.0.0.0, or switch the host to 127.0.0.1.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Port number for the API server.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Authenticate requests with an API key.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Hosts allowed to access the server, separated by commas.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Allow cross-origin requests to the API server.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Enable detailed server logs for debugging.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Time to wait for a response from the local model, seconds.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Local model to load automatically when the server starts.
localApiServer.trustedHostsInvalid: Not a valid host: {{hosts}}. Use a host or host:port, like example.com or 192.168.1.5:3000.
localApiServer.trustedHostsUnsaved: Unsaved. Press Enter to save, Escape to undo.
localApiServer.serverToolsDesc: Run tools server-side for chat endpoints.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: To help us improve Flint, you can share anonymous data like feature usage and user counts. We never collect your chats or personal information.
privacy.privacyPolicy: You have full control over your data. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
privacy.analyticsDesc: To improve Flint, we need to understand how it's used—but only with your help. You can change this setting anytime.
privacy.privacyPromises: Your choice here won't change our core privacy promises:
privacy.promise1: Your conversations stay private and on your device
privacy.promise2: We never collect your personal information or chat content
privacy.promise3: All data sharing is anonymous and aggregated
privacy.promise4: You can opt out anytime without losing functionality
privacy.promise5: We're transparent about what we collect and why

general.replyLanguageDesc: Make the model always answer in this language in chats, Cowork and rooms. Automatic follows what you write.
general.fallbackModelsDesc: If the chosen model is overloaded, unreachable or not loaded, retry the message on these models in order.
general.couldNotRelocateToRoot: Cannot relocate data folder to root directory. Please choose another location.
general.couldNotResetRootDirectory: Cannot reset data folder when it's set to a root directory. Please delete the data folder manually.
general.failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Failed to relocate data folder. Please try again.
general.buildUpdateDesc: When on, Flint asks GitHub once on start (at most twice a day) whether a newer stable release exists. Off by default.
general.buildUnknown: Could not check for updates right now.
general.buildToastDesc: A new version is ready to download from the release page. Installed copies do not update themselves.
general.updateChannelDesc: Which releases to follow. Install and Downgrade open the release page to download the installer; Flint does not update itself.
general.channelEmpty: Press Check now to list the versions on this channel.
general.channelNone: No releases on this channel yet.
general.downgradeDesc: Older versions may not read chats, settings or other data written by this one, and data already moved to a newer format is not converted back. Back up your Flint data folder before installing. The release page opens so you can download the installer.
general.checkForUpdatesDesc: Check if a newer version of Flint is available.
general.autoUpdateCheckDesc: Automatically check for updates on startup and periodically.
general.factoryResetDesc: This will reset all app settings to their defaults. This can't be undone. We only recommend this if the app is corrupted.
general.keepAppDataDesc: Your chat history and conversations will be preserved.
general.keepModelsAndConfigsDesc: Downloaded models, engine settings, and MCP configurations will be preserved.
general.clearWebDataDesc: Removes cached local storage and UI preferences kept by the app window. The interface resets to its default state.
general.huggingfaceTokenDesc: Your HuggingFace API token for accessing models.

hfToken.empty: Please enter a Hugging Face token to validate
hfToken.validDesc: Your Hugging Face token is valid.
hfToken.invalidDesc: The provided Hugging Face token is invalid. Please check your token and try again.
hfToken.timedOutDesc: The validation request timed out. Please check your network connection and try again.
hfToken.failedDesc: A network error occurred while validating the token. Please check your internet connection.

general.closeToTrayDesc: Closing the window hides Flint to the system tray instead of quitting. Quit from the tray menu.
general.downloadLimitDesc: Cap model downloads at this many MB per second. 0 means unlimited.
general.hfEndpointDesc: Where model search and downloads go. Pick a mirror if huggingface.co is blocked or slow where you are.
general.hfEndpointEnvOverride: The HF_ENDPOINT environment variable is set to {{value}} and overrides this setting.
general.hfEndpointSendToken: Send my token to this mirror
general.hfEndpointSendTokenDesc: Off by default: your Hugging Face token only goes to huggingface.co. Turn on only if you trust this mirror.
general.exportLogsDesc: Save the app log with known API keys and tokens removed, to attach to a bug report. Review it before sharing.
general.importChatGptDesc: Bring in your chats from a ChatGPT data export. Pick the conversations.json file from the export zip.
general.importChatGptNone: No conversations found in that file
general.diagnosticBundleDesc: Save the version, environment and redacted app log as a .tar.gz to attach to a bug report. Nothing is uploaded.
general.diagnosticBundleFailed: Could not save the diagnostic bundle
general.documentationDesc: Learn how to use Flint and explore its features.
general.releaseNotesDesc: See what's new in the latest version of Flint.
general.discordDesc: Join our community for support and discussions.
general.reportAnIssueDesc: Found a bug? Help us out by filing an issue on GitHub.

migrateJan.title: Migrate from JAN
migrateJan.desc: Bring data from an existing JAN installation into Flint — copy, reuse in place, move, or start fresh.

cli.installedDesc: Installed at {{path}} — use flint from your terminal to serve models.
cli.desc: Use flint from your terminal to serve models without opening the app.
cli.foreignDesc: Found at {{path}}, installed by another copy of Flint. Install here to use this copy's CLI.

general.keepAwake: Keep the computer awake during runs
general.keepAwakeDesc: Stops Windows from going to sleep while an agent run is working. The screen may still turn off.
general.siteIconsDesc: Shows each website's own icon next to its name in search results and citations. Fetching an icon tells that site you looked at it. Off shows a letter instead.

attachments.subtitle: Configure document attachments, size limits, and retrieval behavior.
attachments.enableDesc: Allow uploading and indexing documents for retrieval.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Choose how parsed documents are added to conversations.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Fraction of the model context used as the cutoff for inlining parsed files on local models.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Maximum size per file. Enforced at upload and processing time.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Minimum similarity score (0-1). Only used for linear cosine search, not ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Choose between sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, or auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Approximate max characters per chunk for embeddings.

changeDataFolder.title: Change Data Folder Location
changeDataFolder.description: Are you sure you want to change the data folder location? This will copy all your data to the new location and restart the application. Your existing data folder is left in place and is not deleted.

claudeCode.overridesTitle: Claude Code settings that override these models

overrides.model: {{file}} pins the model to "{{value}}", so Claude Code keeps using it whatever is set here. Delete the "model" line from that file, or run /model in Claude Code and pick Default.
overrides.env: {{file}} sets {{key}} in its env block, which wins over the variable Flint exports. Remove {{key}} from that env block.
overrides.apiKeyHelper: {{file}} sets an apiKeyHelper, which replaces the token Flint exports and can make Claude Code ask you to log in again. Remove the "apiKeyHelper" line from that file.

claudeCode.contextRaised: Raised the context of {{model}} to {{context}} tokens so Claude Code can run on it.

contextShortfall.memory: {{model}} will run with a {{context}}-token context, the most that fits in this device's memory. Claude Code needs about {{needed}}, so long requests may fail. Choose a smaller or more compressed model.
contextShortfall.trained: {{model}} was trained for only {{context}} tokens of context. Claude Code needs about {{needed}}, so long requests will fail. Choose a model with a larger context.
contextShortfall.user-setting: {{model}} is set to a {{context}}-token context in its model settings, which wins over the automatic choice. Claude Code needs about {{needed}}, so long requests may fail. Raise Context Size in the model's settings.

memory.automaticallySaveDesc: When this is off, anything Flint infers is offered for your approval before it is kept. Explicit saves always work. Memories never leave this machine.
memory.storedDesc: How many memories are kept in each scope, and how much space they use.
memory.rememberedDesc: Search, edit, pin and forget what Flint remembers for this chat, this project, or across chats.

compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.autoDescription: Make room before a conversation outgrows the model's context window. Shared by Chat, Cowork and the CLI.
compaction.compactAtDescription: When the conversation reaches this share of the context window, older messages are summarized first. Automatic keeps the built-in point. Runs before llama.cpp's context shift drops anything.
compaction.reserveDescription: Headroom kept free: compaction starts once a conversation uses more than the window minus this.
compaction.keepRecentDescription: The most recent messages an agent run always keeps word for word.
compaction.strategyDescription: Summarize older messages with the model, or drop them with a note.
compaction.saveFailed: The compaction policy could not be saved
compaction.leanToolsDescription: With a context window of 32K tokens or less, leave the plugin list, image search and widget tools out of chats, so the window holds the conversation. Web search, MCP and agent tools stay.
compaction.smallContextDescription: For a context window of 64K tokens or less, send a leaner system prompt, a names-only skills list, less memory and fewer tools. Safety rules, approvals and the sandbox are unchanged.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Used for primary actions, selection, tabs and focus. Success, warning and error colours never change.
accent.defaultValues: Neutral slate, matches the rest of the interface
accent.independentOfTheme: Markers and links are adjusted for contrast in each theme; your colour stays the button fill. The accent is independent of Light, Dark and System theme.
accent.hexHelp: Six hex digits, such as #3B6EA5. A valid value applies as you type.
accent.hexInvalidCharacters: “{{value}}” contains characters that are not hex digits. The current accent is unchanged.
accent.hexInvalid: “{{value}}” is not a valid hex colour. Use six digits such as #3B6EA5. The current accent is unchanged.
accent.nearSuccess: This accent is close to the success colour. Selected items also use a side marker and labels, and success always shows a check icon.
accent.nearDanger: This accent is close to the error colour. Destructive buttons stay outlined and say what they remove.
accent.previewLabel: Preview of the accent in this theme

appearance.completionSoundDesc: Play a short sound when a chat reply or a Cowork run finishes on its own. Not played for a reply you stopped or one that failed. "Only when approval is needed" is silent on finish and sounds when a run waits for your approval.
appearance.increaseContrastDesc: Make text brighter so it is easier to read. Whiter on the dark theme, darker on the light theme.
appearance.reduceMotionDesc: Turn off animations in Flint. Flint does not follow the system setting, so motion stays on unless you switch this.
appearance.performanceModeDesc: Reduced turns off blur, large shadows and looping animations and updates streaming text less often, for slower computers. Auto picks it when this computer looks slow.

pageDesc.general: Language, the data folder, logs and app-wide options.
pageDesc.appearance: How Flint looks on this computer.
pageDesc.memory: What Flint remembers between conversations, and where it is kept.
pageDesc.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts. Choose a shortcut to change it; a combination already in use is refused.
pageDesc.assistants: Assistants set the instructions a conversation starts with.
pageDesc.attachments: How files attached to a message are read and searched.
pageDesc.mcpServers: External tools Flint connects to through the Model Context Protocol.
pageDesc.webSearch: Let Flint search the web when a conversation needs it.
pageDesc.claudeCode: Run Claude Code with models Flint provides.
pageDesc.extensions: Extensions installed in this copy of Flint.
pageDesc.agentTools: Files, shell and network access for Flint's built-in agent tools.
pageDesc.localApiServer: An OpenAI-compatible server other apps can use to reach your models.
pageDesc.httpsProxy: Send Flint's internet requests through a proxy.
pageDesc.chat: How conversations look, send and behave.
pageDesc.data: Where Flint keeps your data, and how to move, back up or remove it.
pageDesc.integrations: Claude Code, Jev and installed extensions.

imageDescription.title: Images and text-only models
imageDescription.enabled: Describe images for models that cannot see
imageDescription.enabledDesc: A model without vision gets a written description of each attached image, made by a model that can see, in the image's place. Off, it gets nothing for the image.
imageDescription.modelDesc: The model that writes the descriptions. A local model is used only if you pick it here.
imageDescription.modelAuto: Automatic (first remote model that can see)
imageDescription.noVisionModel: No model that can see is available. Add one, or mark a model as vision-capable, to use this.
imageDescription.embedDesc: Also store each image's description with the chat's documents so it can be searched later. This sends every attached image to the description model.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.maxParallelDesc: How many campaign tasks may run at once, each in its own split pane. From 1 to 6. It applies to a running campaign at once; free panes still limit it.

note.title: Note to {{task}}
note.placeholder: Tell the task what to do differently

handoff.title: Handoff: {{task}}
handoff.empty: No handoff has been written yet.

diff.title: Files changed by {{task}}
diff.empty: No file changes were recorded for this task.

review.title: Review and apply
review.body: This runs the gate on the merged result, then creates one proposal for your checkout. Nothing is applied until you approve that proposal.
review.noCommand: No build or test command is configured or detected, so the merged result will not be built or tested.
review.proposal: Proposal created. Review and apply it on this board.
review.failed: The gate failed; the campaign stays in review.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this campaign?
cancelConfirm.body: Every unfinished task is cancelled and running tasks are stopped. Worktrees are kept.

proposal.title: Campaign changes
proposal.missing: The proposal could not be found. Run Review & apply again.

board.resumed: Resumed {{n}} task(s) that were interrupted when the app stopped.
board.stalled: {{n}} task(s) show as running but nothing is running them in this window. Open Cowork to continue them.

headline.attention_one: Needs your attention: {{count}} task is waiting for you
headline.attention_other: Needs your attention: {{count}} tasks are waiting for you
headline.interrupted: Stopped when the app closed: {{done}} of {{total}} tasks done
headline.gateFailed: Final checks failed: the work is merged but not verified

board.planning: Planning… waiting for the coordinator's plan.

word.verifyBlocked: Finished, but the check could not decide

stop.one: It stopped after a command failed.
stop.many: It stopped after commands failed {{count}} times.

headline.working_one: Working on it: {{count}} step so far.
headline.working_other: Working on it: {{count}} steps so far.
headline.conflict: Finished, but its changes clash with what other tasks wrote.
headline.queued: Starts as soon as there is room.
headline.needsInput: Paused: it asked you a question.
headline.needsApproval: Paused: it needs your approval to go on.
headline.verifyBlocked: Finished, but the check could not tell whether it is right.

story.noRecord: No step by step record is available for this task.

next.retry: Try again, and say what it should do differently.
next.conflict: Open the conversation and ask it to rebuild on the latest results, or skip it.
next.open: It has used its retries. Open the conversation to see where it got stuck, or skip it.
next.answer: Open the conversation and answer its question.
next.approve: Open the conversation and approve or deny the request.
next.verify: Check it again, or accept it yourself if you can see it is fine.
next.help: This needs a different approach. The suggested hint is filled in; change it if you like and retry.

story.hintLabel: Tell it what to do differently

summary.title: The whole picture
summary.sideBySide_other: These {{count}} tasks ran side by side
summary.branchBody: Everything is collected on a separate branch, {{branch}}. Your own files stay untouched until you review and apply it.

board.effort: About {{percent}}% of the work is done

recovery.acceptWhy: Why is it fine to accept? One line, kept with the task.

changes.title: Everything this campaign changed
changes.body: All finished tasks together, file by file. Nothing is applied to your folder from here.

conflict.explain: This task and another one changed the same lines, so Flint could not combine them on its own.

board.effortGateFailed: The final checks failed, so the work is not finished

stranded.explain: This task waits for {{tasks}}, which was skipped, so it cannot start on its own.

skipConfirm.title: Skip "{{task}}"?
skipConfirm.body_one: {{count}} other task waits for it. Skip it as well, or let it run without this one?
skipConfirm.body_other: {{count}} other tasks wait for it. Skip them as well, or let them run without this one?
skipConfirm.cascade_one: Skip it and the task that waits for it
skipConfirm.cascade_other: Skip it and the {{count}} tasks that wait for it
skipConfirm.release: Skip it, run the others without it

gate.title: Checks failed
gate.body: The work was merged, but the final build and test check did not pass, so it is not ready to apply.
gate.reviewWarning: The final checks failed. Review the changes with that in mind.

recheck.stalled: The check is taking longer than expected.

changes.unavailable: The changes could not be read. Open the session to see them.
changes.none: This task has not changed any files.
changes.namesOnly: Only the file names are known for this task.
changes.uncommitted: Some of this work is not saved to the task's branch yet.
changes.binaryNote: This is not a text file, so there is nothing to show.
changes.fileCut: This change is long, so only the start is shown.
changes.noPatch: There is no line-by-line view for this file.

start.title: New campaign
start.prompt: Describe the big task. Flint will plan how to split it.
start.placeholder: For example: add dark mode across the app, with tests
start.hint: Up to {{n}} threads work at the same time. You can change this in Settings.
start.noFolder: Open a git folder to start a campaign

error.no-model: Choose a model that can use tools first (Models in the sidebar, or the model picker), then start again.
error.failed: Flint could not open the campaign session. Nothing was started; try again.

list.subtitle: Big tasks split into parts that several agents work on side by side.
list.emptyHint: A campaign takes one big task, splits it into smaller ones, and has several agents work on them at the same time on their own branches.
list.skipped_one: Skipped {{count}} unreadable campaign record. The files were left in place.
list.skipped_other: Skipped {{count}} unreadable campaign records. The files were left in place.
list.needsDesktopHint: Open Flint's desktop app to see and start campaigns. A plain browser tab has nothing to read them from.
list.staleApp: This copy of the app is older than the page. Close it and restart it so it picks up the latest build.

plan.saveFirst: Save or discard your plan changes before allowing.
plan.addAfter: Add a task to wait for

field.title: Task name
field.acceptance: How we know it is done (one per line)
field.paths: Files and folders it may change (one per line)

estimate.generic: Depends on how many files the tasks read and how often a check has to be repeated.

issue.tooMany: {{count}} tasks is too many; the limit is {{max}}.
issue.emptyBrief: {{task}} needs a description of what to do.
issue.badPath: {{task}}: "{{path}}" is not a folder or file inside the project.
issue.unknownDependency: {{task}} waits for a task that no longer exists.
issue.cycle: These tasks wait for each other: {{tasks}}.
issue.overlap: {{a}} and {{b}} would run at the same time but both change {{path}}. Make one wait for the other.

backup.securityChanges: This backup changes where requests go:
backup.keyDropped: Its saved API key will be removed; enter it again for the new address.
backup.tlsChangeOff: {{provider}}: certificate checks turned off (invalid TLS certificates accepted)
backup.includePermissionsWarning: These decide which tools run without asking and where traffic goes. Only do this for a backup you made yourself.
backup.permissionsSkipped: Left unticked, your current security settings are kept.
backup.title: Backup and sync
backup.exportDesc: Save your preferences to a JSON file. To sync across machines, save it into a Google Drive or Nextcloud folder and import it on the other machine. Chats and per-machine state are not included.
backup.secretsWarning: The file will contain your API keys in plain text. Keep it private, and do not put it in a shared folder.
backup.importDesc: Replace your preferences with a backup file. The window reloads afterwards.

dataBackup.title: Data backup
dataBackup.exportDesc: Save conversations, assistants and settings to one JSON file. API keys and other secrets are never included.
dataBackup.exportFailed: Could not save the data backup
dataBackup.importDesc: Add conversations and assistants from a backup file. Items you already have are kept as they are.
dataBackup.previewCounts: This backup has {{threads}} conversations ({{messages}} messages) and {{assistants}} assistants.
dataBackup.previewExisting: {{threads}} conversations and {{assistants}} assistants already exist here and will be skipped.
dataBackup.restoreSettings: Also restore settings (replaces your current settings; permissions and proxy are kept)
dataBackup.importFailed: Could not restore the data backup

startup.title: Start with the computer
startup.on: On. Flint starts when you sign in, using a {{platform}}.
startup.off: Off. Flint starts only when you open it. Turning this on asks first and shows exactly what is written.
startup.minimizedDesc: Start hidden so only the tray icon shows; click it to open the window.
startup.confirmBody: This writes exactly the entry below to your user account, and nothing else. It needs no administrator rights.
startup.confirmUndo: Turning the switch off removes this entry.
startup.failed: Could not change the startup entry

sidebarItems.title: Sidebar items
sidebarItems.description: Choose which items appear in the left sidebar. Hiding one only removes its shortcut; the page itself keeps working.
sidebarItems.reachable: Hidden items stay reachable from the command palette and from Settings.

memoryPage.useSavedDesc: When this is off, Flint adds no saved memory to any request. Your memories are kept and can still be managed here.
memoryPage.useFactsDesc: Turning a scope off stops it being sent. Nothing is deleted; turning it back on uses it again.

chat.blurb: Remembered only inside the conversation it was saved from.
chat.clearBody: Everything remembered for this conversation stops being used and its text is removed from this machine. This cannot be undone in one step.

project.blurb: Available to every conversation in the project you choose below, and to no other project.
project.clearBody: Everything remembered for this project stops being used and its text is removed from this machine. This cannot be undone in one step.

user.blurb: Available everywhere. Keep this for things that are true generally.
user.recallAria: Use memories shared across all conversations
user.clearBody: Everything remembered across all conversations stops being used and its text is removed from this machine. This cannot be undone in one step.

stored.chooseProject: choose a project to count its memories

memoryPage.recallOff: Recall is off for this scope: these are kept, but not sent.
memoryPage.noProjectFolders: No project attached to any session
memoryPage.chooseProjectAbove: Choose a project above to see and manage its memories.
memoryPage.waitingBody: Nothing here is being used yet. An unanswered proposal is never added to a prompt.
memoryPage.conflictsBody: Neither side is being used. These remembered facts contradict each other, so Flint leaves both out of every request here until you keep one.
memoryPage.editBody: This is used in future conversations in the scope it belongs to.

toast.settingsFailed: Memory settings could not be saved

memoryPage.noMatchHint: Check the spelling, or clear the search to see everything here.
memoryPage.emptyHint: Write one above, or let Flint remember as you chat.

chatMentions.title: Conversation mentions
chatMentions.readAny: Let the assistant read any conversation
chatMentions.readAnyDesc: Off by default. Normally the assistant can read only the conversations you mention with @ or #. When on, it can open any chat, session or room on this computer by id. What it reads stays on this computer and is marked as reference data.

bulk.title: Your conversations
bulk.desc: Archive or delete chats, Cowork sessions, rooms and campaigns in bulk. Nothing happens until you confirm.
bulk.campaignsDeleteOnly: Campaigns have no archive, so they can only be deleted.
bulk.campaignsUnavailable: Campaigns need the Flint app or a Flint server.
bulk.keepPinnedDesc: Pinned chats are skipped. Cowork sessions, rooms and campaigns cannot be pinned.
bulk.archiveRowDesc: Moves the selection to the Archive. You can restore it from there, or undo right after.
bulk.archiveOff: Archiving is not available here: the Archive is off or cannot be reached.
bulk.deleteRowDesc: Removes the selection for good. Running items are skipped.
bulk.archiveBody: They leave your lists and move to the Archive. You can restore them from there or undo right after.
bulk.deleteBody: This removes them for good and cannot be undone.

detail.thread: Messages, attachments and the search index of each chat.
detail.cowork: Transcripts and records. A session's worktree goes with it only when it has no unmerged work; otherwise the session is kept and reported.
detail.room: Settings and journals of each room.
detail.campaign: The plan and records of each campaign. Git branches, worktrees and project folders are left alone.

bulk.projectsSafe: Your project folders are never deleted.
bulk.skippedRunning: skipped, it started running after you confirmed.
bulk.skippedNoArchive: Not archived, campaigns have no archive: {{n}}.
bulk.inArchive: Find them on the Archive page.
bulk.scopeAll: Covers everything in the list, not only the rows the current filter shows.

chat.reasoningDefaultDesc: Whether thinking starts on or off in a new chat. A model's own Reasoning setting and the composer toggle still win. Models that cannot switch thinking are left alone.
chat.rulesDesc: Standing instructions added to chats after the assistant's own instructions. Switch one off for a single chat from that chat's options panel.
chat.rulesPlaceholder: Add a rule, e.g. "Answer in metric units"
chat.rulesTooLong: Active rules are about {{tokens}} tokens, over the suggested {{budget}}. Long rules use context in every chat.

usageAttribution.title: Usage by item
usageAttribution.description: Calls and subagent tokens over the last {{window}}, from the session logs.
